experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form an $f0 dependency chain.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fmov.d $f0, $f8; fmov.d $f1, $f9; fmov.d $f2, $f10; fmov.d $f3, $f11; fmov.d $f4, $f12; fmov.d $f5, $f13; fmov.d $f6, $f14; fmov.d $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'fmov.d $f0, $f8; fmov.d $f1, $f9; fmov.d $f2, $f10; fmov.d $f3, $f11; fmov.d $f4, $f12; fmov.d $f5, $f13; fmov.d $f6, $f14; fmov.d $f7, $f15'

notes: Latency 1 cycle(s) and throughput 0.25 CPI for the operand combination(s) recorded above, measured with ./bench on LA664.
